MonoBrowser Mobile 0.2.3

Fixes
- Reddit (and other sites) scroll again: the ad blocker hid Reddit's cookie notice, but the page kept its scroll lock, so the feed stopped after a moment. Filter-list rules that restore styles (`:style(...)`) are now applied too, and a built-in fix covers Reddit
- After an update the ad blocker starts right away from the lists already on the device, without waiting for the network

Open in app
- Links that want to start an app (`intent:`, `market:`, and app links such as `reddit://`) now ask "Open in app" / "Stay in browser" instead of starting the app at once; app links that used to do nothing now work
- The question names the app, or lists the apps that can open the link (e.g. store apps) when there is no default; "Stay in browser" opens the page's own web fallback when it has one
- After answering, a blank in-between page (like Reddit's "Open app" redirect) is left behind and you are back on the page you tapped
- Pages cannot start apps or show the question on their own: only within a few seconds of your tap, and only once per tap
- Email, phone, SMS and map links open as before, without asking

Install: download `MonoBrowser-0.2.3.apk`, open it and allow installing from your browser/file manager when Android asks. If Google Play Protect asks to scan the app, choose "Scan app". Optionally verify it against `MonoBrowser-0.2.3.apk.sha256` (`sha256sum -c`).
Requires Android 8.0 or newer. Updating from 0.2.2 keeps your tabs, bookmarks and settings; 0.2.2 also offers the update in the app.

Downloads:
- Android: `MonoBrowser-0.2.3.apk` (+ `MonoBrowser-0.2.3.apk.sha256`)
